paper.authors: Ju Feng and Wen Zhong Shen
paper.title: Solving the Wind Farm Layout Optimization Problem Using Random Search Algorithm

same_lineage_public_assets.role: same-lineage Horns Rev 1 coordinate and V80 curve completion

paper_source_conflicts: The target Figure-1 ideal domain is visibly 4000 m with an 80 m rotor and 400 m grid, whereas the cited Mosetti/Grady benchmark is frequently represented by the dimensionally equivalent 2000 m, 40 m and 200 m scaling.
Algorithm 1 does not define how to exit a remembered successful ray if every positive step subsequently leaves the feasible polygon.
The Horns boundary enlargement is stated as 7D in both main parallelogram directions without numeric vertices.
The target supplies Figure-1 GA layouts but no machine-readable coordinates; exact red-circle grid occupancies must be digitized.
The target supplies no Horns coordinate, V80 power/CT or speed-quadrature arrays.
missing_information: author Fortran 95 source and random states
Horns coordinate, boundary and V80 arrays
completion_decisions: Use the target paper's dimensionless 4000 m, 80 m and 400 m ideal scaling.
Digitize the Figure-1 red GA locations exactly on its 10 by 10 grid for the 30, 39 and 39 turbine starts.
Use the platform-audited Mosetti/Grady 36 by 3 Case-3 Figure reconstruction.
Use pinned same-lineage public PyWake Horns coordinates and V80 tables while retaining target Table-3 Weibull data.
Use uniform turbine, direction and bounded-step draws; clear the remembered ray after an infeasible proposal to avoid the paper's undefined outward-ray trap.
Use continuous rejection starts for ideal cases and bounded affine stratified jitter for dense Horns random starts.
Use 0.5 m/s normalized Weibull bins over 0 to 30 m/s and offshore z0=0.0002 m.
Use five symmetric robustness values at -20, -10, 0, 10 and 20 percent or degrees.
Implement the paper's one-moved-turbine wake update and moved-turbine constraint check, not a repeated full layout calculation.

decision_variables.resolution: 2N continuous x,y coordinates for fixed N=30,39,39 or 80

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct continuous coordinates; no grid decoder during search

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize expected farm power; fixed turbine count makes this identical to minimizing target CoE

constraints_and_repair.resolution: square or affine parallelogram boundary and pairwise distance >=5D; infeasible trials consume no complete-layout FES

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen expansion, analytic partial rotor overlap, RSS deficits, ideal cubic/rated power and pinned V80 power/CT curves

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: three ideal cases; target Table-3 measured and constructed Horns Weibull cases; 360 optimization directions; 0.5 m/s bins

initialization.resolution: digitized Figure-1 GA starts or random feasible ideal starts; original public Horns layout or feasible affine-stratified starts

update_order.resolution: one turbine moves; accepted moves retain turbine and direction; failed objective or infeasible outward ray returns to the random branch; strict improvement commits

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 100000 complete feasible layout evaluations including the initial evaluation; infeasible retries are not FES

parameters.resolution: uniform turbine, direction and step; step bounded by long farm edge; minimum spacing 5D; 360 Horns sectors

paper_native_cases.resolution: three ideal and three Horns optimization cases, two initializations each, plus direction preprocessing and Case-1 robustness probes

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: 100 ideal or 40 Horns runs per case and start, power/efficiency/best/mean/std, exact FES, accepted and infeasible moves, stage timings, worker receipts and science hashes

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of Algorithm 1 and every native problem/probe family; not author Fortran, random states, unavailable arrays or exact numerical replay
